title: Recent Spate of Fires at Coffee Shops
what_it_is: Recent Spate of Fires at Coffee Shops

sections.label: HDB coffee shop fires
sections.summary: HDB says SCDF investigates coffee shop fires and tenants are liable for damage repairs, including floor tiles of flats above.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yee Chia Hsing
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for National Development whether the Ministry is looking into the root cause of the recent HDB coffee shop fires and whether warranties for floor tiles of units above the affected coffee shops can be provided to these residents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: These include excessive open flames from cooking stoves, poor housekeeping of stalls or poor maintenance of the exhaust system.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: The Singapore Civil Defence Force (SCDF) investigates the cause of all reported fires and may, if necessary, introduce new guidelines to enhance fire safety at the coffeeshops.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: If residential units are affected by fire in the coffee shops, the Housing and Development Board (HDB) will inspect these flats and assess what damage may have been caused.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Under HDB's tenancy agreement or memorandum of lease with coffeeshop tenants or lessees, the tenant or lessee is liable for any damage arising from acts of negligence.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Should a fire break out, HDB will require the tenants or lessees of the coffee shops to follow up with the necessary repairs, including to the floor tiles of units above the affected coffee shops.

sections.label: Coffee shop exhaust and tile warranties
sections.summary: Minister says coffee shop tenants must keep exhaust ducts clean and tile warranty depends on the warranty period.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: On the first question, it is the responsibility of the tenant of the coffee shop, the lessee, to make sure that their exhaust duct is kept clean.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: SCDF has guidelines and if they are found not to be complied with, action will be taken.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As for the second question, I do not think the Member is referring specifically to popping tiles which occur after a fire has broken out.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But if he is referring to other circumstances where these things occur after a period of time, then you need to look at whether it is within the warranty period.
